quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #14
										  					
  

37 Questions • Passing Score 32

questions.question: When passing on a multilane highway:

options.text: Make sure the passing lane is clear.
There is no need to signal.

questions.correctAnswerText: Make sure the passing lane is clear.
questions.explanation: Before you pass, check that the passing lane is clear. Use your turn signal to show you are changing lanes.

questions.question: When driving near a motorcycle, motorists should:

options.text: Assert their place on the road.

questions.explanation: Signal clearly so the motorcycle driver knows your intentions. Failing to signal properly can cause the motorcycle to swerve or leave the road. This is illegal and may result in fines. If someone gets hurt, you can be charged and fined.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn left.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This yellow sign warns you that traffic is merging from the right. Be ready to safely let the traffic merge in.

questions.question: Distracted drivers are at greater risk of a crash when using which of the following?
questions.explanation: Cell phones, radios, and CD players can all distract you and increase crash risk.

questions.question: Double solid yellow lines in the middle of the road mean:

options.text: Passing is allowed from either direction.

questions.explanation: Double solid yellow lines mean you cannot pass in either direction. You may only cross these lines to turn left or to pass pedestrians, bicyclists, scooters, or skateboarders when it is safe.

questions.question: What is the only way to lower your blood alcohol concentration (BAC)?

options.text: Wait for your body to process the alcohol.

questions.correctAnswerText: Wait for your body to process the alcohol.
questions.explanation: Time is the only way to lower your BAC. Coffee, exercise, and cold showers cannot reduce your BAC or make you sober.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and prepare to stop if cars are approaching.
Come to a full stop, then go when it is safe.
Proceed carefully through the intersection without always stopping.
Stop only for traffic on an intersecting road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a full stop, then go when it is safe.
questions.explanation: A stop sign requires a complete stop. Let vehicles and pedestrians pass, then go when it is safe.

questions.question: How can you help prevent rear-end collisions?

options.text: Check your mirrors and blind spots before stopping.
Release the gas pedal and slow down before braking.

questions.explanation: Sudden stops make it hard for drivers behind you to avoid hitting you. Release the gas to let your vehicle slow, then apply steady brake pressure to stop smoothly.

questions.question: When in a travel lane on the roadway:

options.text: You may stop to drop off passengers.
You may stop to look up an address.
You may back up or make a U-turn if you miss your exit.
Do not stop. Keep moving until you can safely pull off the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Do not stop. Keep moving until you can safely pull off the road.
questions.explanation: Never stop in a travel lane. Keep driving until you can safely pull off the road. If you miss your turn or exit, go to the next one.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: A community group is picking up trash on the highway ahead.
Workers are on or near the road in the work zone ahead.
There is a pedestrian crosswalk ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Workers are on or near the road in the work zone ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that workers may be on or very close to the road ahead. Drive with extra care through this area.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: The road ahead turns sharply right, then left.
The road ahead turns sharply left, then right.
The road ahead curves to the left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead turns sharply right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you the road will turn sharply to the right and then to the left.

questions.question: This is a ____ sign.
questions.explanation: This triangular sign is a "Yield" sign. Slow down and check for traffic. Give the right-of-way to pedestrians and oncoming traffic. Stop only if needed.

questions.question: The amount of space you need to cross traffic depends on:

options.text: Road conditions, weather, and oncoming traffic.
The presence of a stop sign.

questions.correctAnswerText: Road conditions, weather, and oncoming traffic.
questions.explanation: The space you need to cross traffic depends on road conditions, weather, and oncoming traffic.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign shows a traffic rule you must follow. U-turns are not allowed where this sign is posted.

questions.question: Before going down a steep hill, you should:
questions.explanation: Shift into a lower gear before driving down a long, steep hill. This prevents your brakes from wearing out by overuse on the hill.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on yellow. They alert you to upcoming hazards. This sign warns that a traffic signal is ahead. Be ready for a yellow or red light.

questions.question: When the driver behind you wants to pass, you should:

options.text: Slow down to give them room to pass safely and easily.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down to give them room to pass safely and easily.
questions.explanation: Slow down when someone behind you wants to pass. This gives them enough space in front of your vehicle to complete the pass quickly and safely.

questions.question: A flashing red traffic signal is the same as:
questions.explanation: When you see a flashing red signal, you must stop. Yield to all traffic that does not have to stop.

questions.question: You are driving up a hill behind a heavy truck. You should know that:

options.text: The truck may be going slower than the speed limit.
You may not be able to safely pass the truck.
You may not be able to legally pass the truck.

questions.explanation: Large trucks often travel slower than the speed limit, especially going uphill. Be careful when approaching from behind. On hills with poor visibility, it is illegal to pass another vehicle.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the overpass ahead is low. Do not drive under it if your vehicle is taller than the height shown on the sign (13 feet 6 inches in this case).

questions.question: A work zone:

options.text: Is marked with black and white signs.
Does not require a driver to slow down and pay extra attention.

questions.explanation: Work zones can be fixed in one place or moving, such as vehicles striping lines, mowing, or removing snow. Work zones have orange signs with black letters or symbols. Always slow down and stay alert in work zones.

questions.question: You may not park:

options.text: On a crosswalk or in a marked bicycle lane.
Within 12 inches of the right side of the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: On a crosswalk or in a marked bicycle lane.
questions.explanation: You cannot park on a crosswalk or in a marked bicycle lane. When parking on the street, you must park within 12 inches of the side of the road.

questions.question: You must drive carefully near a pedestrian with a white cane because:

options.text: He or she is a police officer.
He or she has poor balance.

questions.explanation: A white cane or guide dog means a pedestrian is blind. Slow down, give them the right-of-way, and be ready to stop to prevent hitting them.

questions.question: Defensive driving is:

options.text: Identifying dangerous driving situations and taking action to avoid accidents.
Defending yourself against poor drivers by getting ahead of them in traffic.
Following the vehicle ahead of you at a close distance.
Quickly changing lanes and shifting in and out of traffic congestion.

questions.correctAnswerText: Identifying dangerous driving situations and taking action to avoid accidents.
questions.explanation: Defensive driving means spotting dangerous situations and acting before an accident happens. It helps you avoid conflicts with aggressive, careless, or impaired drivers and pedestrians.

questions.question: An inattentive driver is a driver who:

options.text: Stares at objects off the roadway or daydreams while driving.
Maintains eye contact during a conversation with a passenger while driving.
Only watches the vehicle ahead of their vehicle.

questions.explanation: Do not get distracted by passengers, looking for items in your car, reading, sightseeing, or daydreaming. Keep checking the road, your mirrors, and your instrument panel regularly. These safe habits will help you stay focused while driving.

questions.question: What is the most common cause of traffic crashes?
questions.explanation: Crashes often happen when one driver does not see another vehicle or when a driver does something unexpected. Communicate with other drivers to help prevent crashes.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road ahead has a series of turns or curves.

questions.question: A double solid yellow line down the center of a two-lane road means:

options.text: Lanes are moving in opposite directions and drivers are not permitted to pass.
Lanes are moving in opposite directions and drivers are permitted to pass when it is safe to do so.
Lanes are moving in the same direction and drivers are not permitted to pass.
Lanes are moving in the same direction and drivers are permitted to pass when it is safe to do so.

questions.correctAnswerText: Lanes are moving in opposite directions and drivers are not permitted to pass.
questions.explanation: Yellow lines separate traffic moving in opposite directions. Solid lines mean you cannot pass.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You must travel at the speed indicated.
The maximum legal speed on the roadway is 55 mph.
You must travel through the intersection at the posted speed.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum legal speed on the roadway is 55 mph.
questions.explanation: This is a speed limit sign. It shows the fastest you can legally drive on this road. In rain, snow, ice, or other bad conditions, you may need to drive slower than the posted limit.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a regulation sign. It tells drivers to keep right to avoid a hazard ahead.

questions.question: How often must a vehicle pass a safety inspection?
questions.explanation: Your vehicle must pass a safety inspection once a year before you can renew your registration. The inspection must happen within 90 days of your renewal date. Some counties also require an emission inspection.

questions.question: What should drivers do in bad weather?

options.text: Speed up to reach their destination faster.

questions.explanation: On wet roads, increase the distance between your car and the car in front of you.

questions.question: Which statement is true?

options.text: It is okay to follow motorcycles closely.
A motorcycle with two riders is more balanced than one with a single rider.
You must move completely into the left lane before passing a motorcycle.
Motorcycle brake lights turn on when the rider slows down.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must move completely into the left lane before passing a motorcycle.
questions.explanation: Motorcycles need a full lane width. Be sure your entire vehicle is in the left lane before passing a motorcycle on the left.

questions.question: A transit bus is signaling to re-enter the roadway. What must you do?
questions.explanation: You must yield to any transit bus that is signaling to return to the roadway after stopping. Slow down, change lanes, or stop if needed to let the bus safely enter traffic.

questions.question: What headlights should you use when driving in fog?
questions.explanation: Use low beam headlights in fog. Slow down and watch for the taillights of the car in front of you.

questions.question: Your right wheels leave the pavement. What should you do?

options.text: Pull completely off the road and get back on when safe.
Speed up and steer back onto the road quickly.
Release the accelerator, slow down, then ease back onto the road safely.

questions.correctAnswerText: Release the accelerator, slow down, then ease back onto the road safely.
questions.explanation: Stay calm. Release the accelerator and steer parallel to the road. Slow down and ease back onto the pavement with both hands on the wheel and a small steering adjustment. Check for traffic before returning to the road.
